Results.ReviewText: 1st Weber! Wow! What a high quality product. I’ve always had “cheap” grills and adapted to using them. First thing I noticed was the quality of the materials used, second's was the heat it produces and how evenly it does so, I can’t wait to use this in the dead of winter when it’s 20 degrees outside! Yes I grill year round. Webers customer service is excellent. The grill was missing a couple of screws, they were very helpful in resolving this problem and they had them at my door in by days, so of the best customer service people I’ve ever dealt with. Honestly their customer service was so good that there is no question at all that when my current grill needs to be replaced it will be with another Weber.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Things I like: Simple Assembly, particularly the already-attached nuts.
 Smaller, more efficient area when cooking for 2 to 4 people. Less susceptible to winter temps and winds. 
I like the fuel indicator weighing the bottle directly. The cast iron grills seasoned nicely and quickly. The drawer-like grease trap is a huge advantage over other grills I've owned with dangling cans.
Things I don't like: Less susceptible to winds is not completely immune from winds draining heat away. Three burners might be better. Huge heat probe jutting down from the thermometer.
Results.Title: Needs More Power, Less Draft, or Both

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.

Welcome to the Weber family.
